decisions.reason: The Garamond selection does not necessarily change the whitespace-balancing requirement; message 90 already separately records the current and next-issue balance methods.
Selecting Garamond for article body text does not change author names, photographs, sizing, shape, coverage, or source.
The body-typeface choice does not alter the requirement to break up excessive uninterrupted text with images, blurbs, or quotes.
Garamond is selected specifically for article body typography and does not necessarily modify the broader brand-aligned visual style or red-color rule.
The article body font selection does not change the requirement that advertisement assets render clearly.
Preference for Garamond at 100% view does not change the flipbook deliverable or its balanced two-page-spread behavior.
The body-typeface selection does not alter the table-of-contents completion condition or page-number accuracy requirement.
Selecting Garamond for body text does not change the requirement to enhance image quality when needed.
The selected body typeface does not change the digital launch target or its deadline.
